records.claimText: Habitat considerations: Pet release spreads this species into new wetlands. Releasing or abandoning animals in parks is illegal.
records.note: This is a labelled habitat-care interpretation based on the animal’s stated habitat needs and NParks viewing guidance. It is not a measured population trend.

records.claimText: Watch quietly from a distance. Do not feed, catch or handle wildlife. Leave the animal an open escape route.
records.note: NParks guidance supports distant observation, no feeding or handling, and an open escape route.
